text: Biotechnology is an interdisciplinary major that integrates biology, chemistry, engineering and other fields. By applying the principles of life sciences and using technical means such as genetic engineering, cell engineering and fermentation engineering, it realizes the transformation and utilization of biological systems to solve practical problems in the fields of medicine, agriculture, environment and industry. This major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, aiming to cultivate compound talents with innovative thinking and technological development capabilities.
